whenToUse: You need a longer explanation, links, or buttons than a tooltip allows.
People change a simple setting without leaving the screen.
You show details about an element only when they're wanted.
whenNotToUse: It's a decision that must be answered.
You'd put a long form or scrolling content inside.
It's a short label that should open on hover alone.

alternatives.name: Accordion
alternatives.reason: An explanation that should always sit in the page flow.

accessibility: Set aria-expanded and aria-controls on the trigger to announce whether it's open.
Move focus into the panel when it opens, and back to the trigger when Esc closes it.
Clicking outside closes it, but the rest of the page stays usable.
Give the panel role="dialog" and an accessible name tied to its title.
